heading: Legal Notice
intro: This page summarizes the operator details, nature of the service, and data handling practices of JOBSAPO in accordance with relevant Japanese laws and common compliance requirements for job-matching platforms.

companyProfile.title: Company Profile
companyProfile.addressValue: Fukaya Building 5-A, 4-22-10 Koto, Sumida-ku, Tokyo 130-0014, Japan

whatWeProvide.title: What JOBSAPO Provides
whatWeProvide.description: JOBSAPO is a web platform that provides job and candidate information and matching opportunities between employers and job seekers.

notPartyToContracts.title: Not a Party to Employment Contracts
notPartyToContracts.description: The Company is not a party to employment contracts between employers and job seekers. Employment conditions and hiring decisions are determined by employers, and users act at their own responsibility.

placementFees.title: Placement Fees (Current Status)
placementFees.description: At present, the Company does not charge or receive any placement fees or success-based commissions from employers or job seekers through JOBSAPO.
placementFees.note: In the future, if JOBSAPO is operated as a licensed paid employment placement service, additional disclosures such as license number, fee table, and complaint handling may be added after obtaining the required license.

limitationOfLiability.title: Limitation of Liability
bullets: False, misleading, or illegal job postings are prohibited.
Discriminatory expressions that may violate laws and regulations are not allowed.
The Company may review, request corrections, or remove listings when necessary.

compliance.title: Compliance & Prohibited Conduct
compliance.intro: Users must not engage in the following:
bullets: Posting or registering false or inaccurate information
Posting content that may violate Japanese laws (employment-related, immigration-related, etc.)
Acts against public order and morals, or involvement with antisocial forces
Infringing third-party rights (copyright, trademark, privacy, etc.)
Unauthorized access, excessive load, scraping, or any disruption to the service

dataWeCollect.title: Data We Collect
bullets: Name and contact details (phone, email, etc.)
Address, education, work history, qualifications, desired job/location
Nationality and date of birth; optional immigration-related self-declared information
Device data, access logs, IP address, cookies and identifiers

purposesOfUse.title: Purposes of Use
bullets: Job matching and communications
User management, identity verification, fraud prevention
Inquiry handling and important notices
Service improvement and usage analytics

sharing.title: Sharing with Third Parties
sharing.description: We may share necessary user data with employers and related parties for matching purposes. We do not provide personal data to third parties without consent unless required by law.

retention.title: Retention
retention.description: We retain personal data only for the period necessary to achieve the purposes of use or as required by law.

requests.title: Requests by Users
requests.description: Users may request access, correction, deletion, or suspension of use of their personal data in accordance with applicable laws.

security.title: Security Measures
security.intro: We implement reasonable security measures to protect personal data, including:
bullets: Access control and least-privilege management
Encrypted communications (e.g., HTTPS)
Logging, monitoring, and anti-unauthorized access measures
Vendor oversight for outsourced processing (including cloud services)

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: We may use cookies and similar technologies to improve usability and analyze usage. Users can disable cookies in browser settings, but some functions may not work properly.

noWarranty.title: No Warranty
noWarranty.description: We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, legality, or timeliness of information provided on this service.

disputesDamages.title: Disputes and Damages
disputesDamages.description: We are not liable for any disputes or damages arising from the use of this service, including hiring cancellations, mismatched conditions, or labor-related issues.

serviceSuspension.title: Service Suspension
serviceSuspension.description: We may suspend or interrupt the service due to maintenance, system failures, disasters, or other unavoidable reasons.
